primary.name: Weekly Gaming Digest
guidance: Use this as the main gaming report format.
Rank the week across platform, subscription, major release, update, industry, esports, and tracked-game developments.
Include smaller tracked-game updates only when they matter to active players or explain a coming action.

watch.name: Gaming Watch
triggerIf: important tracked-game patch, maintenance, event, roadmap, monetization, server, release, or availability update
major platform/store/subscription update affecting PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Steam, Epic Games Store, Game Pass, or PlayStation Plus players
major game announcement, release date, delay, cancellation, studio closure, acquisition, layoff, or policy change
credible urgent player-impact issue such as outage, rollback, exploit response, account/security action, or disruptive balance change
rejectIfOnly: routine shop rotation, minor cosmetic post, creator drama, low-signal rumor, review-score-only item, evergreen guide, or ordinary deal roundup
tracked games have no verified material update
general gaming news exists but would be better saved for the weekly digest

audience: PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo ve mobil oyun haberlerini takip eden oyuncular
Yeni oyun, patch, etkinlik, vitrin, abonelik ve platform gelişmelerini hızlıca görmek isteyen okurlar
Oyun sektörü, stüdyo, yayıncı, mağaza, donanım ve üretim tarafındaki gelişmeleri önemseyen takipçiler

guidance: For each enabled tracked game, check official sources first, then credible community/news sources.
Prefer patch notes, maintenance notices, release windows, monetization/store changes, esports calendar changes, events, server issues, roadmap posts, and regional availability or pricing impact.
Reject routine shop rotations, minor social posts, content creator drama, unsupported leaks, and low-signal community speculation.
In Gaming Watch mode, do not create a report solely to say there is no update.
In Weekly Gaming Digest mode, mention quiet tracked games only when the absence itself is useful context.
